description: Land Acquisition - Hewanawattha, Mallawapitiya D/S Division, Kurunegala District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act. It provides detailed descriptions of specific land parcels being acquired by the government, including lot numbers, land names, uses, claimants, and extents. The content focuses entirely on land/property matters, specifically the compulsory acquisition of land for public purposes, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
